name: czgame_frame_on_create
description: CZGameFrame::OnCreate delegates to CFrameWnd::OnCreate, loads and attaches the GAMEBMP bitmap on success, shuts down the mouse device, and returns 0.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
CFrameWnd::OnCreate, AfxFindResourceHandle, CGdiObject::Attach, and LoadBitmapA are MFC/Win32 provider contracts.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x443a60 validates forwarding CREATESTRUCTA to CFrameWnd::OnCreate, returning -1 immediately on failure, otherwise resolving the GAMEBMP resource with type 2, calling LoadBitmapA("GAMEBMP"), attaching the bitmap to self->m_gameBitmap, calling zInput::Mouse_ShutdownDevice, and returning 0.
The dependency frontier for 0x443a60 has no source blockers after accepting zInput::Mouse_ShutdownDevice.
The native smoke patches the MFC/Win32 providers and verifies both the -1 early return and the successful bitmap attach plus mouse-shutdown path.
